mapper.select: SELECT business_name FROM business WHERE seller_id = #{seller_id}

SELECT b.business_name as business_name, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN u.delivery_state = 'finished' THEN p.payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalSales, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN u.delivery_state = 'finished' THEN p.used_point ELSE 0 END), 0) as usedPoints, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN u.delivery_state = 'cancel_order' THEN p.payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalRefunds, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN u.delivery_state = 'finished' THEN p.payment_amount WHEN u.delivery_state = 'cancel_order' THEN -p.payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as netSales, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) as orderCount, b.commission_rate as commission_rate FROM business b LEFT JOIN goods g ON b.seller_id = g.seller_id LEFT JOIN userorder u ON g.goods_num = u.goods_num LEFT JOIN payment p ON u.order_id = p.order_id WHERE b.seller_id = #{seller_id}
AND DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_time, '%Y-%m') = #{selectedMonth}
